calc-97.intro: Compute sample size and actual sampling error, then allocate strata quotas by the largest-remainder method: every quota is non-negative and sums exactly to n.

analysis-54.title: Qualitative (Research / Method / Analysis) Path
analysis-54.intro: Code qualitative text and theme tags with quoted fields, backslash escapes or pipe delimiters, so commas inside the text are preserved. Blank text rows are reported by line and blocked.

en.title: Qualitative (Research / Method / Analysis) Path
en.intro: Code qualitative text and theme tags with quoted fields, backslash escapes or pipe delimiters, so commas inside the text are preserved. Blank text rows are reported by line and blocked.

analysis-52.title: Focus Group (Moderation / Analysis) Techniques
analysis-52.intro: Count mentions, cumulative share and mention-weighted score from a code table. Counts must be non-negative integers and errors are reported by line; CR3 is not applicable with fewer than three codes.

en.title: Focus Group (Moderation / Analysis) Techniques
en.intro: Count mentions, cumulative share and mention-weighted score from a code table. Counts must be non-negative integers and errors are reported by line; CR3 is not applicable with fewer than three codes.

analysis-50.title: Competition
analysis-50.intro: Compute sample-scope shares and CR3/CR5/HHI; optionally enter the total market size. A full-market concentration verdict is given only at 100% coverage, otherwise the result is labeled sample-only.

en.title: Competition
en.intro: Compute sample-scope shares and CR3/CR5/HHI; optionally enter the total market size. A full-market concentration verdict is given only at 100% coverage, otherwise the result is labeled sample-only.

analysis-49.title: Scale Analysis (Reliability / Validity / Factorability)
analysis-49.intro: Check Cronbach α, KMO and Bartlett from item responses. Every non-empty row is validated by line number, so a one-column record is reported instead of silently dropped.

en.title: Scale Analysis (Reliability / Validity / Factorability)
en.intro: Check Cronbach α, KMO and Bartlett from item responses. Every non-empty row is validated by line number, so a one-column record is reported instead of silently dropped.

analysis-51.title: Public Opinion (Monitoring / Analysis / Reporting) System
analysis-51.intro: Summarize manually entered positive, neutral and negative volume, negative-rate changes, peaks and absolute negative volume. Thresholds are adjustable and data-coverage limits are always shown.

en.title: Public Opinion (Monitoring / Analysis / Reporting) System
en.intro: Summarize manually entered positive, neutral and negative volume, negative-rate changes, peaks and absolute negative volume. Thresholds are adjustable and data-coverage limits are always shown.

tester-17.title: Product Concept Assessment and Pricing Test
tester-17.intro: Score a product concept, and when respondent-level four-question data is entered, draw Van Westendorp cumulative curves and derive PMC/OPP/PME/IDP. Four aggregate prices produce only a clearly labeled simplified reference, never an “optimal” price or launch recommendation.
tester-17.h1: Product Concept Assessment and Pricing Test

assessor-50.title: Comprehensive Advertising Effectiveness Assessment
assessor-50.intro: Compute the Advertising Effectiveness Index (AEI) from reach, frequency, CTR, memory, attitude and spend. Zero reach, zero recall and zero cost are valid and only make the affected ratios undefined.
